comment:
* Utility methods for dealing with (typically {@code Nullable}) {@link Collection}s
 *
 * Unless a method specifies otherwise, a null value for a collection is treated as an empty
 * collection of that type.

methods.name: public static boolean contains(@Nullable Collection<T> collection, T element)
methods.comment: * @see Collection#contains(Object)

methods.name: public static List<T> filter(@Nullable List<T> list, java.util.function.Predicate<? super T> predicate)
methods.comment:
* Returns a list of items from the provided list that match the given condition.
     *
     * This is similar to {@link Stream#filter} but without the overhead of creating an intermediate
     * {@link Stream} instance

methods.name: public static Set<T> filter(@Nullable Set<T> set, java.util.function.Predicate<? super T> predicate)
methods.comment: * @see #filter(List, java.util.function.Predicate)

methods.name: public static void addIf(@Nullable List<T> source, @NonNull Collection<? super T> dest, @Nullable Predicate<? super T> predicate)
methods.comment: Add all elements matching {@code predicate} in {@code source} to {@code dest}.

methods.name: public static List<O> map(@Nullable List<I> cur, Function<? super I, ? extends O> f)
methods.comment:
* Returns a list of items resulting from applying the given function to each element of the
     * provided list.
     *
     * The resulting list will have the same {@link #size} as the input one.
     *
     * This is similar to {@link Stream#map} but without the overhead of creating an intermediate
     * {@link Stream} instance

methods.name: public static Set<O> map(@Nullable Set<I> cur, Function<? super I, ? extends O> f)
methods.comment: * @see #map(List, Function)

methods.name: public static List<O> mapNotNull(@Nullable List<I> cur, Function<? super I, ? extends O> f)
methods.comment:
* {@link #map(List, Function)} + {@link #filter(List, java.util.function.Predicate)}
     *
     * Calling this is equivalent (but more memory efficient) to:
     *
     * {@code
     *      filter(
     *          map(cur, f),
     *          i -> { i != null })
     * }

methods.name: public static List<T> emptyIfNull(@Nullable List<T> cur)
methods.comment:
* Returns the given list, or an immutable empty list if the provided list is null
     *
     * This can be used to guarantee null-safety without paying the price of extra allocations
     *
     * @see Collections#emptyList

methods.name: public static Set<T> emptyIfNull(@Nullable Set<T> cur)
methods.comment:
* Returns the given set, or an immutable empty set if the provided set is null
     *
     * This can be used to guarantee null-safety without paying the price of extra allocations
     *
     * @see Collections#emptySet

methods.name: public static Map<K, V> emptyIfNull(@Nullable Map<K, V> cur)
methods.comment:
* Returns the given map, or an immutable empty map if the provided map is null
     *
     * This can be used to guarantee null-safety without paying the price of extra allocations
     *
     * @see Collections#emptyMap

methods.name: public static int size(@Nullable Collection<?> cur)
methods.comment: * Returns the size of the given collection, or 0 if null

methods.name: public static int size(@Nullable Map<?, ?> cur)
methods.comment: * Returns the size of the given map, or 0 if null

methods.name: public static boolean isEmpty(@Nullable Collection<?> cur)
methods.comment: * Returns whether the given collection {@link Collection#isEmpty is empty} or {@code null}

methods.name: public static boolean isEmpty(@Nullable Map<?, ?> cur)
methods.comment: * Returns whether the given map {@link Map#isEmpty is empty} or {@code null}

methods.name: public static List<T> filter(@Nullable List<?> list, Class<T> c)
methods.comment: * Returns the elements of the given list that are of type {@code c}

methods.name: public static boolean any(@Nullable List<T> items, java.util.function.Predicate<T> predicate)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether there exists at least one element in the list for which
     * condition {@code predicate} is true

methods.name: public static boolean any(@Nullable Set<T> items, java.util.function.Predicate<T> predicate)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether there exists at least one element in the set for which
     * condition {@code predicate} is true

methods.name: public static T find(@Nullable List<T> items, java.util.function.Predicate<T> predicate)
methods.comment:
* Returns the first element from the list for which
     * condition {@code predicate} is true, or null if there is no such element

methods.name: public static T find(@Nullable Set<T> cur, java.util.function.Predicate<T> predicate)
methods.comment:
* Returns the first element from the set for which
     * condition {@code predicate} is true, or null if there is no such element

methods.name: public static List<T> add(@Nullable List<T> cur, T val)
methods.comment:
* Similar to {@link List#add}, but with support for list values of {@code null} and
     * {@link Collections#emptyList}

methods.name: public static List<T> add(@Nullable List<T> cur, int index, T val)
methods.comment:

methods.comment:
* Similar to {@link Set#addAll(Collection)}}, but with support for list values of {@code null}

methods.comment: * @see #add(List, Object)

methods.comment: * @see #add(List, Object)

methods.comment: * @see #remove(List, Object)
